fixed_decode.reset: Restore the same independently qualified prefill cache before each request; reload/read back firmware and safely return ownership between boots.
fixed_decode.boundary: Firmware cached-forward plus greedy selection; host START through safe ownership return and output copy also retained, distinct from model-only timing.
fixed_decode.scope: Seeded fixed-context decode only; not prefill, cold-start, complete generation or endurance qualification.

profile.phases: Non-overlapping phase intervals plus explicit overhead; GEMM/SFPU service is nested within phases and engine cycles are nested within service.
profile.instrumentation: Report enabled/disabled comparison; instrumentation is not presumed free.
profile.cpu_remainder: Phase minus backend service includes scalar arithmetic, scalar memory stalls and local loop overhead; do not call it pure compute.

final_primary_boundary: Resident host START through safe RETURN_CPU and copying generated IDs, including prefill and all mandatory runtime work; independent checking excluded.
statistics_limit: Three measured fixed-context observations are descriptive, not a tail-latency or endurance study.
